faqSales1Q: When do I get my commission?
faqSales1A: Your commission becomes due at the stage set by O2O Boss, usually when the customer pays in full. You can follow it under Earnings.
faqSales2Q: Why was my referral not verified?
faqSales2A: Our team calls every customer. If the number is wrong, the customer is not interested or it is a duplicate, the referral is closed. The reason is shown on the referral.
faqSales3Q: Can I refer the same customer again?
faqSales3A: Yes, for a different need. For the same need, the first referral is protected and a second one may not count.
faqVendor1Q: How fast should I respond to a referral?
faqVendor1A: Accept or decline before the time shown on the referral. Quick replies improve your response rate and bring more referrals.
faqVendor2Q: Why can't I see the customer's phone number?
faqVendor2A: O2O Boss connects you with the customer. Use the chat with back office to fix visits and share updates.
faqVendor3A: Back office checks it before it goes to the customer. O2O Boss also keeps a copy of every quotation.
faqCustomer1Q: Is this service free for me?
faqCustomer1A: Yes. You only pay the vendor for the work you accept in the quotation.
faqCustomer2Q: How do I accept a quotation?
faqCustomer2A: Open Quotations, check the items and total, then tap Accept and type your name to sign.
faqCustomer3Q: Can I ask for changes to a quotation?
faqCustomer3A: Yes. Tap Ask for changes and say what you'd like. The vendor will send a new version.
faqOps1Q: Where do I start each day?
faqOps1A: Home shows what needs you now. Work through it from the top, then check Follow-ups and Tasks.
faqOps2A: Only back office, franchise heads and admin. Vendors, customers and referral partners never see them.
faqLogin1A: On the sign-in screen, tap Forgot password and verify your mobile number to set a new one.
faqLanguageQ: How do I change the language?
faqLanguageA: Go to Profile, then Language, and choose from English and 22 Indian languages.
legalDemoNote: Sample wording for the demo. The final text will be provided by O2O Boss.
terms1Body: O2O Boss connects customers with verified vendors through referrals. By using the app you agree to share accurate information and to use it only for genuine requirements.
terms2Body: Commission is paid on referrals verified and completed through O2O Boss, according to the rules shown in the app at the time of the referral.
terms3Body: Vendors are responsible for their quotations, work quality and delivery timelines. O2O Boss may review quotations before they reach customers.
terms4Body: Keep your user ID and password private. O2O Boss may suspend accounts that misuse the platform.
privacy1Body: Your name, mobile number, city and the details you share about requirements, quotations and payments.
privacy2Body: To verify requirements, connect you with vendors, send updates and calculate commissions.
privacy3Body: Each role sees only what it needs. Customer phone numbers are not shared with vendors unless O2O Boss allows it.
privacy4Body: Calls with our team may be recorded for quality and dispute resolution. All actions are logged for safety.
